text:
maya_csm: Heads up — Velaris Systems showing ~68% drop in token usage over the last 10 days. Champion (Anjali) left last week; new PM not yet engaged. Procurement mentioned a short pilot with LexaAI. Renewal in ~6 weeks, we should triage asap.

liam_ae: On it. Quick context — they run a search+summarization flow, embeddings-heavy. They were on hosted with seat discount. I have a 1:1 with their CTO Friday; I'll try to get the new PM on the call.

harper_successops: I can pull the usage heatmap + top routes. Will run a breakdown by product (embeddings, gen, rerank). Running query now:```SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, sum(tokens) AS tokens, route FROM usage WHERE account = 'velaris' GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day;```ETA 3pm PT.

sam_infra: I checked logs for the same window — no mass auth failures, but I see a spike in 5xxs between 1766460000 and 1766500000 coming from their integration host. Could be upstream causing retries and drop.

emma_pm: Any recent model or prompt changes on our side? If not, likely their infra or procurement. Also: do we have evals showing latency/cost for their workload?

maya_csm: No config or model changes from our side in last 30 days. They did migrate SSO around the same time as the usage drop — possible correlation. I already emailed the new PM (cc'd their CTO) but no reply yet.

liam_ae: Proposal: offer a 2-week dedicated trial (discounted) + SE support to migrate a hot path. If procurement is testing LexaAI, we should propose a short PoV: ingest two sample endpoints, compare p95 latency and cost per 10k tokens.

harper_successops: Actionable asks from us: (1) usage graph + 7/14/30 day deltas, (2) top 10 users by tokens, (3) routes impacted, (4) invoice snapshot for last 3 months. I'll deliver numbers.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: report generated for account Velaris — /reports/velaris/1766542222 (access: eng-sre, customer-success) :page_facing_up:

liam_ae: Perfect. @maya_csm can you attach the recent invoices and any contract terms re: seat pricing so I can draft an offer?

sam_infra: Additional note: the 5xx spike coincides with their edge migration logs showing many 502s to our endpoint. Not our downstream. Recommend asking them for network/edge logs and to validate their retry/backoff logic.

emma_pm: I'll help define PoV metrics: p95 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), token cost delta, and qualitative output parity for the top 3 prompts. We can run a short perf harness on our side if they share a small sample.

maya_csm: OK — plan and owners: Harper pulls BI + invoices (ETA 3pm PT). Sam shares the 5xx snippet + timeframe. Liam drafts 2-week Dedicated PoV + SE hours. Emma defines metrics and a short eval script. I'll schedule a sync with their CTO + new PM for Thu 11am PT and send invite. Deliverables by EOD tomorrow.

liam_ae: I'll prepare a PoV doc template and run pricing scenarios. If they ask about LexaAI, offer the product comparison call + demo with latency/cost numbers.

harper_successops: Started pull; preliminary: embeddings token volume down 75%, gen down ~60%, top 3 endpoints account for 82% of pre-drop tokens. Will attach CSV.

sam_infra: Sending 5xx sample lines to this thread in a sec. No 401s, so not auth.

maya_csm: Thanks team. I'll post the calendar invite and follow-up message to the customer. If we don't get the PM on the Thu call, we'll escalate to the CTO and include procurement. :thumbsup:

liam_ae: Thx — ping me if you need legal on discounts.

emma_pm: I'll sketch the eval harness and share a notebook snippet for their sample payloads.

ops_bot: incident-bot: reminder — renewals team review for Velaris scheduled in 5 days.

maya_csm: Noted — will update the renewal playbook after the PoV.
